comment: 一张图的形状，不是一整本图册：figures.json 是这种对象的列表。 / The shape of one figure, not a whole album: figures.json is a list of these objects.
图从 result.json 的 artifacts 派生，带 sha256；不写死文件名。 / A figure derives from an artifact in result.json and carries its sha256; no hardcoded filename.
model-view 由渲染器按 render 的视角重出；manual 允许出现，但必须在实例里登记 by/date。 / model-view is re-rendered from the render block; manual is allowed but must be registered with by/date.
id / section / caption / source 是待填项；这张模板只给形状，不给具体矿名、路径或阈值。 / id / section / caption / source are to be filled; the template gives only the shape, never a mine name, path or threshold.
section: TODO: 图所在的章节由报告大纲分配 / the report outline assigns the section
caption: TODO: 图注由报告大纲分配，不手打编号 / the report outline assigns the caption and number

source.artifact: TODO: result.json 里 artifact 的 role / the artifact role in result.json
source.sha256: TODO: 产物存在后填入它的 sha256 / fill in the artifact's sha256 once it exists
